versions.name_zh: Health17 全民健保藥品主檔

meta.data_description_zh: 1. 原則上一種藥品一筆資料。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期
等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出
經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
2. 相關資訊可參考中央健康保險署網站→藥材專區→藥品
meta.primary_keys_raw:
藥品主檔(H_NHI_DRUG)分別與全民健保處方及治療醫令明細檔─西醫、中醫及牙醫
門診(H_NHI_OPDTO)比對之鍵值為DRUG_NO(藥品代碼)、與全民健保處方及治療醫
令明細檔─住院(H_NHI_IPDTO)比對之鍵值為 ORDER_CODE(藥品代碼)、與全民健保
處方及治療醫令明細檔─藥局(H_NHI_DRUGO)比對之鍵值為DRUG_NO(藥品代碼)。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health17 全民健保藥品主檔
meta.notes_en: 1. This center's database has been de-identified, removing personally identifiable information such as names and addresses. Fields like IDNO and OVEDR_DATE have been masked, and the data can only be used within a dedicated operational area of this department and statistical results must be reviewed before being carried out to ensure that no specific individual can be identified. 2. Related information can be found on the Central Health Insurance Bureau's website → Chinese Medicine Section → Medicines.
meta.primary_keys_en: The drug master file (H_NHI_DRUG) is compared with the National Health Insurance prescription and treatment order details file - Western medicine, TCM, and dental outpatient (H_NHI_OPDTO), using DRUG_NO (drug code) as the key value. It is compared with the National Health Insurance prescription and treatment order details file - inpatient (H_NHI_IPDTO) using ORDER_CODE (drug code). It is compared with the National Health Insurance prescription and treatment order details file - pharmacy (H_NHI_DRUGO) using DRUG_NO (drug code).
meta.name_zh_en: National Health Insurance Drug Master File
